note: Design-only presentation guidance. It never changes SEOAnalysis scores or statuses.

retrieval_success.finding: The document could not be retrieved
retrieval_success.action: Check whether the page is reachable and returns an HTML document.
retrieval_success.snippet_reason: No server response details are available to form a safe change.

http_status.action: Review the response status and the page route before changing redirects or server rules.
http_status.snippet_reason: A server-side status correction cannot be inferred from the status alone.

https.finding: The final page does not use HTTPS
https.action: Review the final URL and configure secure transport at the hosting layer.
https.snippet_reason: Transport configuration is server-specific; an HTML snippet would not fix it.

content_type.finding: The response is not identified as supported HTML
content_type.action: Review the response content type and serve an HTML document where appropriate.
content_type.snippet_reason: The correct response header depends on the server and document type.

redirects.finding: The redirect path may be longer than needed
redirects.action: Check whether each redirect is necessary and update links to the final destination.
redirects.snippet_reason: Redirect rules cannot be safely generated from the count alone.

fetch_duration.finding: The observed fetch duration needs review
fetch_duration.action: Investigate server and network behavior with production performance tooling.
fetch_duration.snippet_reason: A single static HTML change cannot determine or correct fetch duration.

robots_directives.action: Confirm that the observed directive matches the page owner's intent before changing it.
robots_directives.snippet_reason: Directive changes can affect crawl behavior and require owner review.

title.action: Write one accurate title that reflects the verified page content.
title.snippet: <title>[Write a title based on verified page content]</title>
title.snippet_reason: The placeholder is editable and is not verified page copy.

meta_description.action: Write a concise, accurate description using only confirmed page information.
meta_description.snippet: <meta name="description" content="[Write an accurate summary of this page]">
meta_description.snippet_reason: The placeholder is editable and is not verified page copy.

canonical.action: Confirm the intended canonical destination with the site owner before changing it.
canonical.snippet_reason: The actual target can only be drafted from final_url when a canonical is missing; the owner must confirm it.

h1_structure.finding: The primary heading structure needs review
h1_structure.action: Add one clear H1 that describes the actual page content.
h1_structure.snippet: [Write a primary heading from verified page content]
h1_structure.snippet_reason: No source heading is available to safely reuse.

heading_hierarchy.action: Review the observed heading levels and use a logical outline.
heading_hierarchy.snippet_reason: The correct outline depends on the full page content and structure.

visible_text.finding: The observed visible-text count is a prompt for review
visible_text.action: Check whether the page explains its purpose clearly; word count alone does not establish quality.
visible_text.snippet_reason: The analyzer returns a count, not enough page copy to draft content.

internal_links.finding: The link count may warrant review
internal_links.action: Add useful links only where they help people navigate related content.
internal_links.snippet_reason: Destination URLs cannot be invented from link counts.

anchor_text.finding: One or more link labels need review
anchor_text.action: Give each link a clear label that describes its destination or purpose.
anchor_text.snippet_reason: The analyzer does not return individual link markup or destinations.

link_relationships.finding: Link relationship attributes need contextual review
link_relationships.action: Use relationship attributes only when they match the link's purpose and sponsorship.
link_relationships.snippet_reason: Individual links and their context are not returned.

image_alt.action: Describe informative images; keep empty alt text when an image is genuinely decorative.
image_alt.snippet_reason: The analysis returns aggregate counts. The offline source note supplies one source path only for this static proof.

json_ld.action: Inspect each structured-data block and validate intended values separately.
json_ld.snippet_reason: No type or property values are returned when no block is present; a schema cannot be safely invented.

open_graph.finding: Open Graph preview fields need review
open_graph.action: Use verified page title and description values for sharing metadata.
open_graph.snippet_reason: The analyzer does not provide enough verified copy for absent fields.

twitter_metadata.action: Use verified page title and description values for social metadata.
twitter_metadata.snippet_reason: The analyzer does not provide enough verified copy for absent fields.

html_lang.finding: The document language declaration needs review
html_lang.action: Declare the primary language when it is known.
html_lang.snippet_reason: The correct language must be confirmed by the page owner.

viewport.action: Use a viewport declaration appropriate for the page's responsive layout.
viewport.snippet_reason: The static pattern needs review in the context of the actual site.

charset.action: Declare the document encoding used by the page.
charset.snippet_reason: The correct encoding must match the served document.
